browse_api.description:
La Bolduc – La Bolduc / Volume 1

Vintage Canadian French-language LP by legendary Québécois singer-songwriter La Bolduc (Mary Rose-Anne Travers).

Originally issued in 1958 by Apex Français, catalog ALF-1505, this mono compilation collects classic recordings by one of the foundational figures of popular French-Canadian music. The release is documented as a 1958 Canadian Apex compilation.

Track Listing

Side 1

  • La Pitoune
  • Johnny Monfarleau
  • Les Maringouins
  • Les Médecins
  • La Morue
  • Le Commerçant des Rues

Side 2

  • J'ai un Bouton sur la Langue
  • Le Vieux Garçon Gêné
  • Toujours "L'R 100"
  • La Bastringue
  • Arthimise Marie Le Bedeau
  • Le Jour de l'An

The album contains 12 tracks, including several of La Bolduc's best-known recordings.

Label: Apex Français
Catalog: ALF-1505
Year: 1958
Country: Canada
Format: 12" LP
Speed: 33⅓ RPM
Recording: Mono
Language: French
Genre: Québécois Folk / French Canadian / Traditional Folk
